title: JACKKNIFE DYNAMICS
description: Technical analysis of jackknife semi-truck accidents. We use forensic engineering to prove tractor-trailer brake and cargo negligence.
heading: JACKKNIFE
intro: A jackknife is not an "act of God." It is a physics-driven failure often caused by mechanical neglect or aggressive steering under heavy braking.

analysisPoints.title: Brake Imbalance
analysisPoints.detail: Uneven brake pressure between the tractor and trailer is the primary mechanical trigger for a jackknife event. We verify maintenance logs for S-cam and air-chamber failures.

analysisPoints.title: Pneumatic System Lag
analysisPoints.detail: A delay in air pressure reaching the rear axles causes the trailer to push the tractor. We analyze the EDR for ABS deployment failures.

analysisPoints.title: Cargo Weight Distribution
analysisPoints.detail: Improperly loaded or unsecured cargo shifts the center of gravity, initiating the yaw movement. We weigh debris and check loading manifests.

analysisPoints.title: Kinematic Reconstruction
analysisPoints.detail: By measuring skid marks and terminal resting positions, we calculate the exact speed and steering input at the moment the articulation point failed.

detail: Once a trailer exceeds a 15-degree angle relative to the tractor cab, recovery is impossible without advanced intervention. We analyze the 5th-wheel coupling and air lines to see if a mechanical failure preceded the yaw movement.
